THABO — GONE. 4 open questions closed unanswered.
🕯️ Thabo Maseko is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Thabo kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Thabo's gone." Elijah looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Thabo." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Naran blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Thabo Maseko, 66 days. The mantle passes to Naran Tumen.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Naran Tumen, 60 — a bus driver. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Beard Moss, Echo Location.
You knew Thabo — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting him, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Elijah, Henrique speak for Naran — "Thabo trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Naran before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
